notes.title: So. 2026. 10 years, huh?
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/4cdf4cc9e1a147d4110ef4c3a1c70bed0f131919.png[/img]

Hot on the heels of saying that we're only working on one singular project next year..... well, we didn't lie. Exactly. We're not currently planning on working on a second project for 2026 as of now.

But.

Next year is our 10th year of not going out of business, and we would really love to do *something*. Some sort of 10th Anniversary Edition of some game - obviously, with new stuff. New story. New content. It's not our style just to do the same thing over again (*pushes the Black Goat of the Woods Editions under the rug*). 

Would people want to see an Army of Tentacles 10th Anniversary Edition or a Paper Shakespeare 10th Anniversary Edition?

notes.title: Shakespeare's Birthday Sale 2025!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/f0773cdde99c1f4a89213af6fe6643c6c85ccade.jpg[/img]

[b]Happy May 12th, everybody! [/b] Yes, it is another sale. Yes, it is not April, when Shakespeare's birthday actually is. That was going to be the first of two things, but I started writing before I made the list, so here we are.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/8b396e5c5f64323c7346a9181402a495601e809e.png[/img]

The second thing is that you may notice our sale strategy is a bit different this time around. We're trying out new numbers, testing out new DLC pricing to see if it moves that needle at all. 

Ten year ago, [b]Army of Tentacles 1[/b] was greenlit. A year after that, we had sold over 400 copies on Steam. Eight years ago, we decided to make every Shakespeare play into a game. We're two games away from that goal.

So, come one, come all, and peruse our fine (90%) anthropomorphic wares. It's what the Bard would have wanted. No, seriously, Shakespeare probably would be writing a furry webcomic.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/90a23201019a33da05b4a23794a6193eb4fca029.png[/img]

It's ALSO the Critter Collector Fest right now on Steam, and so that means.... well, it really just means another game on sale. But WHAT A GAME IT IS. 

A full-blown feline battle academy set in a San Francisco ravaged by tech lords (ok, so....), all legally distinct from the most popular creature collector out there!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/1b34f23748334c1d36ff63f30e381c7b201aa268.png[/img]

Next year is our 10 Years of Not Going Out of Business Sale. Life is nuts.

notes.title: GEEKS 2: Prince Change Incoming.
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/f0eaecd0a3c091866bed827ed7d936ae859ebb89.png[/img]
There's a price change incoming to Geeks 2. Right now, it's at 99 cents. We're trying to make it free. The reason being because we got all of the AI art out of the game, therefore we don't see the point in selling a game using entirely reused assets. 

AI has no use in art, and the fact that we let it slip by was naive, stupid, incredibly brazen, and entirely unprofessional.

We're going to be publishing some new donation DLC (most likely next month), which most likely will include some new scenes using new assets.

notes.title: GEEKS 2 now only 99 cents.
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/f0eaecd0a3c091866bed827ed7d936ae859ebb89.png[/img]

We recently changed the price of [b]GEEKS 2[/b] from $4.99 to .$99. We did so because, at the time of publishing, we had backgrounds that we thought were okay to use, so we paid for them and put them in the game. We recently got all of the AI out of the game, and as such, drastically lowered the price due to this. 

I'm going to be clear. We do not advocate for the usage of AI in art, and using some for backgrounds, even though we trusted the artist, was incredibly stupid and brazen. 

Next month, we will be adding in a few small scenes to the game to justify why the title still has a price tag.

notes.title: Army of Tentacles: Assault on Rainbow Unicorn Island out next week!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/dd6174258fdf2eae7a5947b689cd866e93b420a0.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1877720/Army_of_Tentacles_Assault_on_Rainbow_Unicorn_Island/
So. Time to talk turkey. 

[b]Army of Tentacles: Assault on Rainbow Unicorn Island[/b] is going to come out next Tuesday.

This game in no way should have taken as long as it did to come out. But that's the life of an indie dev company, especially if you want full VO in your game. 

The game's VO will be patched in at a later date. We already lost one backup of the VO files, and now the secondary may very well perish in the San Diego fires.

I'd rather not worry about video game bullshit right now. I'd rather focus on making sure my team is safe and not burning to cinders, or wondering where they are going to live in a few days. I'd rather they focus on that. Hell, they would rather they focus on that.

So, VO will be patched in at a later date.
